questions.question: what language should i learn if i want to make a game?
questions.answer: whatever keeps you opening the editor. but if you want a real answer: c# with godot or c++ with raylib. ravioli is built on raylib and it's a joy to work with.

questions.question: how long did it take you to be productive in rust?
questions.answer: about a month of fighting the borrow checker before it clicked. after that, the compiler becomes your pair programmer instead of your enemy.

questions.question: what's your setup look like?
questions.answer: kitty terminal, neovim, tmux, wezterm. all on a mac mini. nothing fancy but it gets out of my way.
